notes: Production art exports (Codex art v1.0.0), the Apollo interface kit v002 faces used as label-free control backgrounds behind native buttons with live text, and the game's audio (Dan's soundtrack, the CC0/CC BY soundscape set, and the generated Quindar tones). Image paths are relative to assets/; audio paths are relative to public/audio/. Per-asset status final is the existing schema-compatible equivalent of delivered. Room badge is intentionally blank for the exact v005 SVG overlay. See docs/BUILD-HANDOFF-M00b.md. Content 0.5.2 (FNO-M01) adds 22 presentation exports: eight astronaut expressions, four Voss/Reed expressions, five prologue/facility backgrounds, three recovery plates and two moving layers; new art is delivered for director review (final is the schema delivery flag, not approval). See docs/BUILD-HANDOFF-M01.md and docs/codex-content-0.5.2/28-Prologue-and-Resolution-Treatment.md. Content 0.5.3 replaces the composite CAPCOM with Jim Lovell; the retired image remains in package art/history. New den layers are awaiting montage assembly, not a cue or opening-stage change.
